portInfo.description: Arctic town-centre berths for smaller/mid ships; Fuglenes for larger LOA. Treat “northernmost town” tourism slogans as unverified marketing — not repeated as fact here.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Sentrum quays: walkable centre per factsheet. Fuglenes: 2.5 km — plan coach/taxi; no timed shuttle primary captured. Anchorage→tender pier 1.5 n.m. on factsheet if used.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Read the day’s quay — Fuglenes is not a pier stroll to Rådhusplassen.
